event: A car nobody recognises has been parked on the same corner for three days.
Malik Reyes and Ofc. Brady Kohl are seen arguing in the street loud enough that people stop.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
text: Ofc. Brady Kohl will not let go of something Cass Deveaux said weeks ago.

event: An ambulance takes someone out of the Terraces before dawn. Nobody says a name.
The Harbor Bar is full and loud and for a few hours nothing is wrong.
